event_id.description: Unique identifier for the Snowplow event. Use it as a primary or deduplication key. Suggested ClickHouse column: `String`.

event_name.description: Name of the Snowplow event. Suggested ClickHouse column: `String`.

app_id.description: Identifier of the application the event was tracked from. Suggested ClickHouse column: `String`.

user_id.description: User identifier set by your application. Suggested ClickHouse column: `String`.

collector_tstamp.description: Timestamp when the Collector received the event, in ISO 8601 format. ClickHouse parses it with best-effort date parsing. Suggested ClickHouse column: `DateTime64(3)`.

web_page_id.description: Page view identifier from the `web_page` entity. If the event has no `web_page` entity, the field is omitted and the column gets its default value. Suggested ClickHouse column: `String`.

domain_userid.description: First-party cookie identifier for the user's device. Suggested ClickHouse column: `String`.

domain_sessionid.description: First-party cookie identifier for the user's session. Suggested ClickHouse column: `String`.
